```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request number to review'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Validate PR number
        if: ${{ inputs.pr_number == '' }}
        run: |
          echo "Error: PR number is required."
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Create Octavia Bot token
        id: octavia_token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed_files
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octavia_token.outputs.token }}
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = process.env.PR_NUMBER;
            const { data: files } = await github.rest.pulls.listFiles({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: prNumber,
              per_page: 100
            });
            const filePaths = files.map(f => f.filename);
            core.setOutput('file_paths', JSON.stringify(filePaths));

      - name: Check for connector changes
        id: connector_check
        run: |
          FILE_PATHS=$(echo '${{ steps.changed_files.outputs.file_paths }}' | jq -r '.[]')
          CONNECTOR_REGEX='^airbyte-integrations/connectors/[^/]+/'
          FOUND=false
          for path in $FILE_PATHS; do
            if echo "$path" | grep -qE "$CONNECTOR_REGEX"; then
              FOUND=true
              break
            fi
          done
          echo "connector_found=$FOUND" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post skip comment if no connector changes
        if: ${{ steps.connector_check.outputs.connector_found == 'false' }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            :warning: No connector changes detected. Skipping AI docs review.
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          comment-tag: ai-docs-review
          mode: replace

      - name: Post started comment
        if: ${{ steps.connector_check.outputs.connector_found == 'true' }}
        id: started_comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ inputs.pr_number }};
            const body = ":hourglass_flowing_sand: AI docs review started...";
            const { data: comment } = await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: body
            });
            core.setOutput('comment_id', comment.id);

      - name: Trigger Devin AI
        if: ${{ steps.connector_check.outputs.connector_found == 'true' }}
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@main
        with:
          comment-id: ${{ steps.started_comment.outputs.comment_id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          playbook-macro: "!connectordocs_pr_review"
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          org-id: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_ORG_ID }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          start-message: "AI docs review in progress..."
          tags: "ai-docs-review"
          wait-for-stopped-status: true
          wait-minutes-max: 30
```
